commands.name: feeds.subscribe
commands.label: Subscribe
commands.description: Subscribe to a feed or podcast by its address. A website address is searched for its feed. A feed the browser cannot read is not subscribed, and the error names why.

commands.name: feeds.check
commands.label: Check a feed address
commands.description: Fetch an address once and say whether the browser can read it as a feed, without subscribing. Blocked feeds are named: cors, network, mixed, http, parse or not-feed, with the words to show.

commands.name: feeds.unsubscribe
commands.label: Unsubscribe
commands.description: Remove a subscription and its stored items. Starred items are kept unless keepStarred is false.

commands.name: feeds.refresh
commands.label: Refresh this feed
commands.description: Fetch one subscription now and store any new items. Items already stored keep their read, starred and played state.

commands.name: feeds.refresh_all
commands.label: Refresh all feeds
commands.description: Fetch every subscription (at most 2 at a time per host, 6 in all). With force false, feeds fetched within their ttl or still backing off after errors are skipped.

force.description: Fetch every feed even if it was fetched recently (default true)

commands.name: feeds.list
commands.label: List subscriptions
commands.description: List every subscription with its id, title, kind (podcast or text), folder, last fetch status and settings. Private addresses are hidden.

commands.name: feeds.set_folder
commands.label: Move to folder
commands.description: Put a subscription in a folder (one level). An empty folder name takes it out of any folder.

commands.name: feeds.rename_folder
commands.label: Rename folder
commands.description: Rename a folder. Renaming onto an existing folder merges the two.

commands.name: feeds.settings
commands.label: Feed settings
commands.description: Read or change one subscription's settings: autoDownload (newest n episodes), speed (0.5 to 3, null for global), skipIntro and skipOutro (seconds), limit (episodes, null for none), refreshMinutes (null for global). Pass no settings to read them.

autoDownload.description: Download the newest n unplayed episodes

skipIntro.description: Seconds to skip at the start

skipOutro.description: Seconds to skip at the end

commands.name: items.list
commands.label: List items
commands.description: List the items of a view, newest first: inbox (all unread), today, starred, podcasts, a feed, a folder or a search. Defaults to the current view.

view.description: One of inbox, today, starred, podcasts, feed, folder, search (default: the current view)

feedId.description: Feed id, for the feed view

folder.description: Folder name, for the folder view

query.description: Words to find, for the search view

limit.description: Most items to return (default 50, at most 500)

commands.name: items.list_unread
commands.label: List unread items
commands.description: List unread items across every feed, or in one feed or folder, newest first.

feedId.description: Feed id, for the feed view

folder.description: Folder name, for the folder view

limit.description: Most items to return (default 50, at most 500)

commands.name: items.open
commands.label: Open item
commands.description: Show one item in the reading view and mark it read.

commands.name: items.mark_read
commands.label: Mark read
commands.description: Mark items read (default: the open item).

commands.name: items.mark_unread
commands.label: Mark unread
commands.description: Mark items unread (default: the open item).

commands.name: items.toggle_read
commands.label: Toggle read
commands.description: Mark the open item unread if it is read, or read if it is unread.

commands.name: items.mark_all_read
commands.label: Mark all read
commands.description: Mark every unread item in a view read (default: the current view). olderThanDays leaves newer items unread.

view.description: One of inbox, today, starred, podcasts, feed, folder, search (default: the current view)

feedId.description: Feed id, for the feed view

folder.description: Folder name, for the folder view

query.description: Words to find, for the search view

olderThanDays.description: Only items older than this many days (0 or missing: all)

commands.name: items.star
commands.label: Star
commands.description: Star items (default: the open item). Starred items are kept even after you unsubscribe.

commands.name: items.unstar
commands.label: Remove star
commands.description: Remove the star from items (default: the open item).

commands.name: items.toggle_star
commands.label: Toggle star
commands.description: Star the open item, or remove its star.

commands.name: items.search
commands.label: Search items
commands.description: Find stored items whose title, author, summary or text contains every word of the query, newest first.

limit.description: Most items to return (default 50, at most 500)

commands.name: view.open
commands.label: Open view
commands.description: Show a view in the item list: inbox, today, starred, podcasts, a feed (feedId), a folder (folder) or a search (query).

view.description: One of inbox, today, starred, podcasts, feed, folder, search (default: the current view)

feedId.description: Feed id, for the feed view

folder.description: Folder name, for the folder view

query.description: Words to find, for the search view

commands.name: items.next
commands.label: Next item
commands.description: Open the next item in the current view and mark it read.

commands.name: items.previous
commands.label: Previous item
commands.description: Open the previous item in the current view and mark it read.

commands.name: items.open_original
commands.label: Open original
commands.description: Open the item's own web page in a new tab (default: the open item).

commands.name: reader.set_prefs
commands.label: Reading settings
commands.description: Change the reading settings: font (sans or serif), text size (14 to 24), line width (narrow, medium or wide), images (load remote images in articles and show notes) and reading theme (light or dark). Send no fields to read the current settings. Returns the full settings.

font.description: Typeface for articles and show notes

width.description: Line width of the reading column

images.description: Load remote images (off: each image waits behind a "Show image" button)

commands.name: reader.show_images
commands.label: Show images
commands.description: Load the remote images in the open article or show notes. With always set, also turn images on for every item from now on.

always.description: Also keep images on for every item

commands.name: player.play
commands.label: Play
commands.description: Play an episode (by itemId), or resume the current one, or start the first in Up Next. Optional `at` starts at that many seconds.

itemId.description: Episode id (default: the current episode, else the first in Up Next)

commands.name: player.pause
commands.label: Pause
commands.description: Pause playback and save the position.

commands.name: player.toggle
commands.label: Play or pause
commands.description: Play if paused, pause if playing.

commands.name: player.seek
commands.label: Go to position
commands.description: Move the playing episode to a position in seconds.

commands.name: player.skip_back
commands.label: Skip back
commands.description: Skip back by the given seconds (default: the skip-back setting, 15 s).

commands.name: player.skip_forward
commands.label: Skip forward
commands.description: Skip forward by the given seconds (default: the skip-forward setting, 30 s).

commands.name: player.next
commands.label: Play next in Up Next
commands.description: Stop the current episode and play the first episode in Up Next.

commands.name: player.set_speed
commands.label: Set playback speed
commands.description: Set the playback speed, 0.5 to 3, with pitch kept. scope "feed" stores it for this podcast only, "global" for every podcast without its own speed. Without scope it updates the podcast's own speed when it has one, else the global speed.

commands.name: player.speed_up
commands.label: Faster
commands.description: Raise the playback speed one step.

commands.name: player.speed_down
commands.label: Slower
commands.description: Lower the playback speed one step.

commands.name: player.sleep_timer
commands.label: Sleep timer
commands.description: Pause after a number of minutes, or stop at the end of the current episode.

endOfEpisode.description: Stop at the end of this episode instead

commands.name: player.cancel_sleep
commands.label: Turn off sleep timer
commands.description: Turn off the sleep timer.

commands.name: player.next_chapter
commands.label: Next chapter
commands.description: Go to the start of the next chapter.

commands.name: player.previous_chapter
commands.label: Previous chapter
commands.description: Go to the start of this chapter, or the previous one when within 3 s of its start.

commands.name: player.chapters
commands.label: List chapters
commands.description: The chapters of an episode (default: the current one) as start seconds and titles.

commands.name: player.state
commands.label: Player state
commands.description: What is playing: episode, position, duration, speed, sleep timer, chapters and Up Next ids.

commands.name: queue.add
commands.label: Add to Up Next
commands.description: Add episodes to the end of Up Next.

commands.name: queue.play_next
commands.label: Play next
commands.description: Put episodes at the front of Up Next, to play after the current one.

commands.name: queue.remove
commands.label: Remove from Up Next
commands.description: Take one episode out of Up Next.

commands.name: queue.move
commands.label: Move in Up Next
commands.description: Move one episode to a position in Up Next (0 is first).

commands.name: queue.clear
commands.label: Clear Up Next
commands.description: Remove every episode from Up Next. The episodes stay in the library.

commands.name: queue.list
commands.label: List Up Next
commands.description: The episodes in Up Next, in order, with titles.

commands.name: episodes.mark_played
commands.label: Mark played
commands.description: Mark episodes played: clears the saved position and takes them out of Up Next.

commands.name: episodes.mark_unplayed
commands.label: Mark unplayed
commands.description: Mark episodes not played.

commands.name: downloads.download
commands.label: Download episode
commands.description: Download an episode file into this browser's private storage for offline play. Refuses with the blocking host named when the file is stream only.

commands.name: downloads.cancel
commands.label: Cancel download
commands.description: Stop a running or queued episode download and discard the partial file.

commands.name: downloads.remove
commands.label: Delete download
commands.description: Delete a downloaded episode file. The episode stays in the list and can still be streamed.

commands.name: downloads.list
commands.label: List downloads
commands.description: List downloaded, running, queued and failed episode downloads with title, size and status.

commands.name: downloads.usage
commands.label: Storage usage
commands.description: Report storage used and available, whether the browser keeps it persistently, and the count and size of downloaded episodes.

commands.name: downloads.persist
commands.label: Keep storage
commands.description: Ask the browser to keep this app's storage (subscriptions and downloads) instead of clearing it when space runs low.

commands.name: downloads.open_panel
commands.label: Storage
commands.description: Open the storage panel: usage, persistence, downloaded episodes and their sizes.

commands.name: downloads.remove_played
commands.label: Delete played downloads
commands.description: Delete the downloaded files of every episode marked played. The episodes stay in the list.

commands.name: search.podcasts
commands.label: Search podcasts
commands.description: Search Apple's podcast directory by name. Returns title, author, feed address, artwork address, genre and Apple id for each podcast with a public feed. Limited to about 20 directory calls a minute.

term.description: Podcast name or words to search for

country.description: Two-letter country code for the Apple store, such as us, gb or in (default: the last one used, else this browser's region)

limit.description: Most results to return (1 to 200, default 25)

commands.name: search.charts
commands.label: Top podcast charts
commands.description: List Apple's top podcasts for a country, in chart order, with feed addresses from one batched lookup. A row whose feedUrl is null has no public feed. Uses two directory calls.

country.description: Two-letter country code for the Apple store, such as us, gb or in (default: the last one used, else this browser's region)

limit.description: How many chart places (1 to 200, default 50)

commands.name: opml.import
commands.label: Import OPML
commands.description: Import subscriptions from OPML 2.0 text. Nested outlines become one folder level; outlines without a feed address are skipped and counted. Every feed is checked for reachability (4 at a time) first; only reachable, new feeds are subscribed, and blocked feeds are listed with the reason. Set checkOnly to list without subscribing. Without text, opens the Import tab of the Add dialog.

checkOnly.description: Check and list the feeds without subscribing (default false)

commands.name: opml.export
commands.label: Export OPML
commands.description: Save every subscription, with folders, as rivulina-subscriptions.opml (into NakliOS storage when hosted, else the save picker or a download). Private feeds, whose addresses carry a token, are left out unless includePrivate is true. Returns the number of feeds saved and left out.

includePrivate.description: Include private feeds whose addresses carry a token (default false)

commands.name: add.open
commands.label: Add podcast or feed
commands.description: Open the Add dialog on one tab: search (Search podcasts), charts (Top charts), address (Feed address) or import (Import OPML). Optional term or url fills the field.

term.description: Search words to fill in and run

commands.name: transcripts.get
commands.label: Show transcript
commands.description: Load the published transcript of an episode (Podcasting 2.0 podcast:transcript: WebVTT, SRT, JSON, HTML or plain text) and return it as text with times and speakers, plus the timed cues.

commands.name: transcripts.search
commands.label: Search transcript
commands.description: Find the lines of an episode transcript that contain a word or phrase (case-insensitive), with the time each is spoken, so the player can seek there.

commands.name: ui.help
commands.label: Keyboard shortcuts
commands.description: Open the help sheet that lists every keyboard shortcut and command. Returns the shortcuts as a list.

commands.name: ui.palette
commands.label: Command palette
commands.description: Open the command palette: type to filter every command, then press Enter to run one.

commands.name: ui.focus_search
commands.label: Search items
commands.description: Move the keyboard focus to the search box in the top bar.

commands.name: ui.back
commands.label: Back
commands.description: On a narrow window, go back one pane: from the reading view to the list, or from the list to the subscriptions.
